description_en: Queries the number of instances that are in each state
description_zh: 用GetInstanceStatusCount获取实例任务不同运行状态的数量统计
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-instance-status-statistic --project-id 1234 --project-env PROD --biz-date 2020-01-01 --scheduler-type NORMAL --dag-type MANUAL --scheduler-period DAY --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceStatusStatistic

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The runtime environment. Valid values: PROD and DEV
parameters.help_zh: 运行的环境，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The date on which the numbers of instances in different states are obtained. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 获取不同实例状态数量的业务日期。格式为yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: biz_date

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling type of the node. Valid values:

NORMAL: auto triggered node
MANUAL: manually triggered node
PAUSE: paused node
SKIP: dry-run node
parameters.help_zh:
调度的类型，取值如下：
NORMAL：周期调度
MANUAL：手动调度
PAUSE：暂停调度
SKIP：空跑
parameters.name: scheduler_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the directed acyclic graph (DAG). Valid values:

MANUAL: DAG for a manually triggered workflow
SMOKE_TEST: DAG for a smoke testing workflow
SUPPLY_DATA: DAG for a data backfill instance
BUSINESS_PROCESS_DAG: DAG for a one-time workflow

<!---->

DAILY
MANUAL
SMOKE_TEST
SUPPLY_DATA
BUSINESS_PROCESS_DAG
parameters.help_zh:
Dag Type的类型：
MANUAL：手动任务工作流
SMOKE_TEST：冒烟测试工作流
SUPPLY_DATA：补数据
BUSINESS_PROCESS_DAG：一次性业务流程工作流
parameters.name: dag_type

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling cycle. Valid values:

MINUTE
HOUR
DAY
WEEK
MONTH
parameters.help_zh:
调度周期。
MINUTE：分钟。
HOUR：小时。
DAY：天。
WEEK：周。
MONTH：月
parameters.name: scheduler_period
